profile.headline: Software Developer Engineer  at Amazon
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in designing/developing network applications, service applications in virtualized environments such as Cloud Network. Strong knowledge of programming languages, system environment and version control tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Kuiper ground software engineer  to support mission operation for Kuiper satellites

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Healthtech Halo Development
- Data pipeline for biometric ingestion from Halo application to backend server
- Rest API that provides health summary data to present workout summaries

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Advertising performance report by migrating data from central advertising big data storage. Built data aggregation service based on Spark and distributed system to provide customized year over year performance data to advertisers

positions.title: Senior Software engineer
positions.description:
KNOX Message Messenger
- Enterprise Integration Server development and operation
- Developed Messenger synchronized with server management systems(JIRA, AWS )

ChatON Web Service

- Developed linux based server-side web service using Java on spring framework
- Designed data storage for web service with SQL(MySQL) and NoSQL(Cassandra)
- Implemented server-to-server/client network using TCP(Netty) and HTTP
- Operated linux based web servers on a cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS)
- Deployed server images and provided solutions to issues in real time

ChatON Opeb API

- Developed restful Open APIs running on ChatON platform
- Worked on ChatON SDK server-side development for gaming features and contributed to develop Samsung Contents \​& Services
- Participated Samsung Developers Conference held in San Francisco as a speaker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed statistics and SNMP(Simple Network Management Protocol) for \\VIM(Virtualization Interface Module)
- Implemented VIC (VNIC Interface Control) protocol library
- Reduced defects in product releases by resolving software bugs and performing unit/integration tests
- Accomplished improvement of products by analyzing and testing various switch modules with engineering tools (i.e., IXIA, ATS (Automated Testing Software), Packet Generator)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Auto Smart Ports (AST), Intern, June - August 2008
- Designed and developed AST which congures features of connected devices automatically by obtain-
ing protocol contents
- Developed unit tests for AST by coordinating shell functions in Internetwork Operating System
